name: Window shell
notes: Activity bar, panels, palette, layout, status bar

features.feature: The activity bar shows Today, Calls, Calendar, Threads, Tasks (Knowledge only with Recall on or a plugin tab) and Settings; icons only until "Expand the sidebar" (⌘\), remembered
⌘1…9 open the activities and ⌘, Settings; an activity opens where the user left it

The actions palette (⌘K, status bar Actions) lists actions on the open call, event or Today, Echo's own, Go to (activities, Settings sections), threads and calls; typing ranks them; unavailable ones are greyed with why; Enter runs, Esc closes
The right and bottom panels show their views as tabs; a view moves to the other panel, the panel closes and resizes; the right panel starts closed at every window open and keeps its last tab
Under 900 px the calls list folds behind "Calls ▾" and the right panel opens over the page; under 600 px high the bottom panel folds
Messages for a moment float as toasts with OK
The status bar shows the next automatic minutes, the default AI profile, Live notes on, Actions and Claude
An `echo://` link opens its place in the window (a call at a moment, a thread, a client, a person, a task, a prep)

The top bar holds the sidebar switch, the Record pill (record and the call's language) and, at its right end, the account chip and the Inbox, on one line and overlapping nowhere from the narrowest window up; on macOS the strip drags the window but its controls click
